type: far void (Desc far *dst, Desc far *src, int x, int y, int flags)

type: near asm (BX = x, AX = y) -> BX, ES, CL, AH

name: race_front
notes: race-mode front page (set by the road renderer; used by `cursor_redraw` when `racing`)

name: g_front
notes: visible page descriptor (DS:AD10 off, AD12 seg); SR1 DS:822A

name: g_back
notes: back page descriptor drawn into (AD14, AD16); SR1 DS:822E

name: driver_id
notes: -2 EGA/VGA, -4 Hercules, -6 Tandy (CGA: type byte FDh in the page descriptor, id stays whatever `driver_select` set); SR1 DS:8236

name: g_nplanes
notes: 4 on EGA/VGA, 1 on CGA/Herc/Tandy; SR1 DS:8238

name: g_px_shift
notes: pixel -> byte shift (3 on EGA/VGA); SR1 DS:823A

name: g_x_align
notes: x alignment mask: 0xFFF8 on EGA/VGA; SR1 DS:823E

name: g_mirror
notes: 1 = also copy drawing from the back page to the front page (double buffering); SR1 DS:8240

name: g_text_fg
notes: text foreground (scheme colours); `AD29` = background; SR1 DS:8242 / 8243

name: g_fill_col
notes: fill colour; `AD2B` = line colour; SR1 DS:8244 / 8245

name: g_frame_style
notes: 0 none, 1 single, 2 double, 3 solid; SR1 DS:8246

name: g_ui_level
notes: UI level (1 after `gfx_init`, 2 after `cursor_init`); SR1 DS:8247

name: g_overscan
notes: overscan (border) register value for `ega_set_palette`; SR1 DS:8248

name: g_text_end_x
notes: end x of the last `draw_text` (AD34 = y); SR1 DS:824C / 824E

name: status_w
notes: status line parameters set by `status_init` (AD36 = 0x58, AD38 = y + 1, AD3A = 0xA0, AD3C, AD3E); SR1 DS:8254.. 8258

name: ui_colours
notes: **new**: UI palette indices set by `gfx_init` (`AD40` .. `AD56`; see `gfx_init`); SR1 DS:8266 / 8268 / 7644..

name: view_rect_ptr
notes: pointer to the view rect; `AD5C/AD5E/AD60` its corner coordinates (`rect_clip_to_view`); SR1 DS:825A..8262

name: g_page
notes: page table: `9A82` page 0, `9A86` page 1, `9A8A` page 2, `9A8E` page 3; SR1 DS:7316..7322

name: g_draw_off
notes: offset part of the line/fill target (`fill_rect`); SR1 DS:767C

name: g_draw_seg
notes: segment of the line/fill/poly target (`DS:9DC2`); SR1 DS:787A

name: g_scheme
notes: colour scheme table in use: `0x1D06` (EGA/VGA/Tandy) or `0x1D56` (CGA); scheme n = 5 bytes at `+5n`... status scheme 11 at `+0x37`; SR1 DS:787E (0x3A0 / 0x3F0)

name: drv_vec
notes: **driver vector table, 20 slots** (see below); `A0CE` = slot 8, `A0DE` = slot 12, `A0F6` = slot 18; SR1 DS:78A2 (15 slots)

name: g_lmask
notes: left masks `00 80 C0 E0 F0 F8 FC FE FF`; `DS:7B99` = right-mask view; SR1 DS:5C15

name: g_font_seg
notes: font segment (26E6); glyph `c` at offset `c*9 - 0x11A`; SR1 DS:691A (seg 0E9F)

name: g_saved_back
notes: pages remembered by `gfx_screen_mode(0)` (`1C48` back, `1C4C` front); SR1 DS:02E6 / 02EA

name: scheme_ega
notes: colour scheme table (5 bytes per scheme) for EGA/VGA; `DS:1D56` = CGA table; SR1 DS:03A0 / 03F0

name: pal_live
notes: live palette register table (16 + overscan); loaded by `pal_load`, applied by `pal_normal`; SR1 DS:0440

name: gear_labels
notes: gear label string pointers (`gear_label`); SR1 DS:0482

name: pic_origin_x
notes: `show_picture_at` origin x, `1E42` y, `1E44` clip/clear height (200); SR1 DS:04BE / 04C0 / 04C2

name: event_id
notes: current event / trip id (2 Bob's, 3 event 15, 4/6 other); selects tile lists in `ega_anim_step`; SR1 DS:0284

name: anim_w
notes: sprite w/h cache of `sprite_anim_advance` (`1BCE` = h); SR1 DS:0288 / 028A

name: g_anim_yoff
notes: sprite height reduction used by the animation code; SR1 DS:02D0

name: tiles6
notes: 6 tile pairs `{x, w}` for event 6 animations; `DS:50E4` = 3 pairs for event 15; SR1 DS:539A

name: g_ptr_save
notes: pointer save-under descriptor (`A2BA`); cursor state block `A2BA..A2E0`; SR1 DS:7AEC

name: scene_ptr
notes: sprite scene header (`sprite_scene_setup` return) with fields `A546..A556`; SR1 DS:7D18

name: page_nodes
notes: animation page ring (16-byte nodes); SR1 DS:7D42

name: scene_sprites
notes: 12-byte sprite records of the scene; SR1 DS:77BA

name: racing
notes: non-zero while a race / event screen is active (redirects the pointer to the race pages); SR1 DS:8ACA

name: page_copy_rect
type: far void (Desc far *src, Desc far *dst, int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1)
